frontier.label: Arithmetic-to-zero-location rigidity
frontier.target: Prove the uniform one-sided Chebyshev PNT-error moment bound against the verified positive kernel, then derive an unconditional zero-location constraint

goal: A complete Lean-verified proof of the Riemann hypothesis

milestones.label: Boundary heat vanishing is equivalent to RH
Poisson decay is equivalent to sublinear cumulative upper spectral height
First-tail frontier is an exact positive-kernel Chebyshev PNT-error moment bound

statusNote: Cutoffs zero and one are proved. Every canonical Legendre center now satisfies r >= log N - 2, so the explicit PNT-error kernel is nonnegative and monotone on every remaining prefix. The open inequality is exactly a one-sided upper moment bound against that positive kernel. Proving it and every RH-forcing rigidity step remain open.
